newsitem.title: CHINA: China first-half economic growth seen over 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: China first-half economic growth seen over 10 pct.

text.p: China's economy is expected to grow by more than 10 percent during the first half of the year, the official Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.
It quoted a report from the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences as saying growth would reach 10.3 percent in the first quarter and 10.6 percent in the second.
The academy said growth would be led by the manufacturing sector, which would post 14.3 percent growth in the first quarter and a 13.7 percent expansion in the second quarter.

Premier Li Peng set a target of eight percent economic growth for all of this year in his government work report, though the State Statistical Bureau has forecast 1997 economic growth of 10.5 percent.
China's gross domestic product growth reached 9.7 percent in 1996.
